answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded water-rights stake, where a violet-tagged ledger entry records the deposit as gale-driven gauge reading rather than a fable of trust. Colluding identities that split one stake are detected when aggregate withdrawals exceed the basin's calibrated yield, since shared provenance collapses under flow accounting. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
